# Minimal Design System Builder

> Free, single-file browser tool for designing a small UI system: a color palette, type roles, button sizes, and spacing, with a live preview and CSS custom-property export. No install. Nothing is uploaded.

Open https://chiedo.github.io/minimal-design-system-builder/ in Chrome, Edge, or Firefox. Edits stay in that browser's local storage. The source is https://github.com/chiedo/minimal-design-system-builder.

## What it does

- Color scales: primary, neutral, accent, danger, warning, and success. Hue, saturation, lightness, light and dark edges, optional hue rotation, and per-shade HSL overrides.
- Type roles: H1 through H6, body, UI, caption, and mono. Font, weight, size step, line height, tracking, and ink.
- Buttons: small, medium, and large, each with its own type step, padding, and icon size. Primary, secondary, tertiary, and danger. Inputs share the selected control height.
- Space: spacing scale, roundness, a separate button radius, five shadows, borders, focus ring, icon sizes, opacity, and max-widths.
- Preview: app screen, color board, type specimen, and components, plus a dark preview exported as a data-theme="dark" block.
- Export: tokens.css and JSON. Paste the CSS at the top of a stylesheet.

## How to export CSS tokens

1. Open the page in Chrome, Edge, or Firefox. There is no install.
2. Set the palette, type roles, button sizes, and spacing. The preview updates as you edit.
3. Choose Download CSS, or open Export and copy CSS or JSON.
4. Paste tokens.css at the top of your stylesheet and use the custom properties.

## Facts

- Price: free
- Install: none
- Account: none
- Data: stays in the browser. An imported palette file is not uploaded.
- Import: JSON, including palette-XX.json from the Refactoring UI Color Palettes ZIP
- Author: chiedo (https://github.com/chiedo)
- Inspired by the workflow in Refactoring UI. Not a copy of the book files.
